subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should the general agent write tool expose `append: true` as a durable model-facing capability after byte-safe recovery is repaired and proven?
rationale: This adds a new public agent-tool capability rather than restoring a previously documented append contract, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish long-term product acceptance.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Adopt the optional parameter after byte-safe recovery, real backend proof, and owner review are complete.

options.title: Keep overwrite-only
options.body: Decline the new tool surface and address shared-file protection through a narrower workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Adopt the optional parameter after byte-safe recovery, real backend proof, and owner review are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history owns the current write-tool composition and backend boundary where this durable capability is implemented.
